elements.element: Trigger: obligations arise on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason

elements.element: Assistance available for up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems
and certify such deletion in writing
up to six (6) months exceeds and encompasses 90 days
within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are express in new 10.3: 6-month assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return in standard machine-readable format, and post-return deletion with written certification.

The 30-day return clock and format obligation run from expiry or termination and are unconditional; the 'at Customer's request' condition attaches only to transition assistance, which is inherently elective, so it does not swallow the mandatory data-return mechanic.

Insertion is a concise new sub-clause for an absent obligation; existing 10.1, 10.2 and 16.5 are untouched and remain effective, and 16.5's deferral of Customer Data to other sections is not disturbed or contradicted.
Minor: 'reasonable' qualifies the assistance obligation and the clause does not fix 16.5's stale cross-reference to a non-existent Section 11 — rationale-level notes only, not deviations.
